items.name: NeuroGraphMamba
items.description: We present NeuroGraphMamba, a hybrid architecture integrating a causal inter-band graph (GrangerEdgeNet), a spatial electrode graph constructed from elec- trode proximity and spectral coherence, and a Mamba state-space layer whose scan order is directed by a cross-attention module guided by the causal graph

items.name: inherited-geometry
items.description: WordNet hypernym chains form arcs in hidden-state space that are inherited from corpus co-occurrence statistics, not built or read by the model. Probing, causal interventions, horseshoe nulls, and corpus-statistics predictions.

items.name: superposition_zoo
items.description: A research harness for studying how sequence-mixing architectures (softmax attention, linear attention, state-space models, delta-rule associative memory, and more) causally shape superposition and feature isolation in learned representations, using ground-truth synthetic benchmarks instead of natural-language probing.

items.name: YingMab
items.description: Mamba is a modern state space model (SSM) featuring input-dependent state transitions and hardware-aware parallel scans using Triton. This implementation demonstrates high-performance sequence modeling through a combination of causal convolutions, selective parameterization, and GPU-optimized recurrent computations.

items.name: vulgaris
items.description: VULGARIS is an open-source foundational model for real-time industrial intelligence, built from scratch in pure NumPy with a custom autograd engine. It combines streaming time-series modeling, state-space recurrence, causal routing, domain adaptation, memory, explainability, safety constraints, drift detection, and edge-ready inference for telemetr
